title: Six ways *into* the Caucasus.
intro: Build a programme around one theme or weave several together. Every itinerary is drafted by our Tbilisi team and adapted to your clients, your season and your budget.

culture.text: Old towns, cave cities and frescoed churches where empires and faiths met, and traditions are lived, not staged.
culture.subject: Narikala, Old Tbilisi
culture.alt: Old Tbilisi at golden hour: red roofs climb towards Narikala fortress, with a domed church on the hill

wine.text: Eight thousand vintages: qvevri wine in family cellars, and a seat at the harvest table.
wine.subject: Rtveli, the grape harvest
wine.alt: Grape harvest in a vineyard: an older man and a boy in traditional dress hold up a basket of black grapes

trekking.text: Glaciers, tower villages and shepherd trails, from easy day hikes to multi-day treks between guesthouses.
trekking.subject: Truso Valley, Kazbegi
trekking.alt: A river winds through the green floor of the Truso Valley between steep ridges, with sunlight breaking through cloud

gastronomy.text: Supra feasts led by a tamada, family kitchens, markets and clay-oven bread, with a dish for every valley.
gastronomy.subject: Mtsvadi, bread and greens
gastronomy.alt: A table laid outdoors with skewers of grilled meat, flatbread, cheese, tomatoes, spring onions and a clay jug

pilgrim.text: Monasteries, rock-cut churches and holy sites still in use, in two of the oldest Christian nations on earth.
pilgrim.subject: David Gareja
pilgrim.alt: The David Gareja monastery complex: cave cells and stone buildings on a green hillside in rolling semi-desert hills

leisure.text: Black Sea shores, spa towns, lakes and ski slopes: a holiday of its own, or a slow finish to a busy tour.
leisure.subject: Batumi at blue hour
leisure.alt: Batumi at blue hour: the lit seafront boulevard and city towers along the Black Sea
